sections.heading: 1. Agricultural Practices
points: **Agriculture** = growing crops and rearing animals for food.
**Crop** = plants of the same kind grown at a place on a large scale.
Two broad seasons in India: **Kharif** (rainy — June–Sept, e.g. paddy, maize, cotton) and **Rabi** (winter — Oct–March, e.g. wheat, gram, mustard).

sections.heading: 2. The Basic Steps
points: **Preparation of soil** — loosening/turning by **ploughing** (plough, hoe, cultivator); adds air and brings nutrients up.
**Sowing** — using good-quality **seeds**; by hand or by a **seed drill**.
**Adding manure and fertilisers** — to replenish soil nutrients.
**Irrigation** — supplying water (wells, canals, tube wells; modern: **drip and sprinkler**).
**Weeding** — removing unwanted plants (weeds); by weedicides or hand.
**Harvesting** — cutting the mature crop (sickle or **harvester**); **threshing** separates grain from chaff.
**Storage** — dried grains stored in silos/granaries, protected from moisture and pests.

sections.heading: 3. Manure vs Fertiliser
points: **Manure** — a natural substance from decomposed plant/animal waste; improves soil texture; e.g. compost, vermicompost.
**Fertiliser** — a chemical (man-made) rich in a nutrient (e.g. urea, NPK); gives quick nutrients but overuse harms soil/water.
**Crop rotation** and growing **leguminous plants (Rhizobium fixes nitrogen)** replenish soil naturally.

sections.heading: 4. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Steps: soil preparation → sowing → manure/fertiliser → irrigation → weeding → harvesting → storage.
Kharif = rainy (paddy, maize); Rabi = winter (wheat, gram).
Seed drill = sowing; sickle/harvester = harvesting; threshing separates grain from chaff.
Manure = natural (compost); fertiliser = chemical (urea, NPK).
Legumes + Rhizobium fix nitrogen; drip/sprinkler = modern irrigation.

sections.heading: 5. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Kharif = rainy season** (paddy/cotton); **Rabi = winter** (wheat/gram).
**Manure** is **natural**; **fertiliser** is a **chemical** — overuse of fertiliser harms soil.
**Threshing** separates **grain from chaff** (after harvesting).
A **seed drill** is used for **sowing** seeds evenly.
